conventions: Assert status and body shape through the shared API client.

generated_test.source: test('rejects invalid code without changing total', async () => { const before = await getOrder(); const response = await applyDiscount('NOPE'); expect(response.status).toBe(422); expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ error: expect.any(String) }); expect((await getOrder()).total).toBe(before.total); });
